name: Skill Editor
description: Author a user-owned Agent Skill (SKILL.md): front-matter fields (name / description / allowed tools / always-on), a markdown body editor, debounced autosave, and server-backed undoable version history.
tagline: Write and version your own agent skills

permission_levels.label: Can edit skills
permission_levels.description: Create and rewrite a skill's SKILL.md — its instructions, allowed tools, and always-on flag — which changes what every agent loading that skill does.
